name: Suu Sasamaru
source:
The “king” of not noticing the romantic intentions of others in the game, calms himself down by reciting useless bits of trivia to himself. He has many faults, but is absolutely dedicated to protecting and supporting the Shikunshi.

[Edited from [url=http://www.neechin.net/article/128/kitto-sumiwataru-asairo-yori-mo-review]Agilis' review[/url].]

[spoiler]His real name is Sasa (笹) and become Sasamaru (笹丸) since 1st and 2nd time in simulated world. But at the same time Sasamaru is his name from previous life, Tomono Sasamaru (伴 笹丸)[/spoiler]
